known_result_boundary: Earlier balanced-challenge results and complete resource-excluded hosted studies were known. They did not select pairs, items, prompts, endpoints, or pass criteria.
resource_exhaustion_rule: Ordinary service, syntax, schema, semantic, adapter, and rate-limit failures remain incorrect in the complete 40-cell end-to-end denominator. If a terminal provider error explicitly states that the shared subscription quota or usage allowance is exhausted, at least 20 scheduled cells remain, and every later cell is a transport failure, the complete hosted minimum-suite study is ineligible for route-conformance reporting. In that case, retain only a redacted full-study exclusion receipt; never select a successful subset.
selection_basis: Reuse the deterministically derived minimum witness: one controlled pair per reachable action edge while jointly covering all twelve authored policy-difference rules. Lexicographic tie-breaking and no model output determine the selected IDs.
